summary: Synchronously dispatch an Event through the native DOM event subsystem and return cancellation status.

semantics.timing: listener invocation is synchronous before dispatchEvent returns
semantics.return_value: false iff event is cancelable and canceled; otherwise true
semantics.path: capture/target/bubble phases follow DOM event path
semantics.listener_exceptions: reported as uncaught by host and do not propagate from dispatchEvent

caveats: Task/async dispatch is incorrect; dispatchEvent itself is synchronous.
Node-tree dispatch must preserve propagation order and stop flags.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § EventTarget.dispatchEvent / dispatching events

tests.name: synchronous dispatch and return true
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let a=[]; t.addEventListener('x',()=>a.push('listener')); a.push('before'); const r=t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); a.push('after'); console.log(a.join(','),r);
